name: Rosato’s
taglineShort: Family-friendly bar and restaurant with open fires, great grub, and stone-baked pizza.

address.landmark: On Malin Road, in the heart of Moville

bookingNote: Bookings are for indoor dining only. Outdoor seating is walk-in.
hoursSummary: Kitchen from 16:00 weekdays · from 15:00 Sat · from 12:30 Sun

hero.imageAlt: Illustration of Rosato’s red façade on Malin Road, Moville

room.title: Open fires, proper food, and a hundred thousand welcomes.
room.body: Rosato’s is a neighbourhood bar and restaurant on Malin Road — stone floors, old wood, and a room that doesn’t hurry you. Irish and Italian plates, stone-baked pizza, and a pint by the fire.
room.imageAlt: Open fire in the hearth at Rosato’s

visit.title: Find us on Malin Road.
visit.parkingTip: Street parking along Malin Road; easier after the school run.

ordering.title: Collection only.
ordering.intro: Choose your pizzas online and collect from the bar. We don’t deliver — pay when you pick up.
ordering.payNote: Pay on collection — card or cash.
ordering.successMessage: Order received. We’ll have it ready for collection.
